integrity: The proof was reconstructed from the slice definition and checked against the cited exact ell_1 formulas and absolute-sum results. Novelty remains subject to the possibility of unindexed equivalent literature.
limitations: The exact formula is proved only for an l1 direct sum with an atomic ell_1(Gamma) component; no extension to other absolute norms is claimed. The finite rational checker is a consistency check, not an infinite-dimensional proof.
title: Exact Daugavet constants after adjoining an atomic ell_1 summand
